surface_mechanism_description: Systematic investigations on the dependence of crystal quality on growth conditions have revealed that low temperature growths tend to result in high carbon incorporation in AlAs epilayers. This fact suggests that some intermediate alkyl species are produced by surface reactions during ALE cycles, and are incorporated in the AlAs layer as carbon impurity.
